title: Certify ShipStation batched multi-account rate fan-out against every live carrier account

acceptanceCriteria.description: The backend canonical rate owner batches account fan-out once per credential source, attributes returned rows to requested carrier accounts, and targets single-account fallback only at missing accounts while preserving the flag-off path.

One live all-source run covers every currently discoverable DR PREPPER and KFG account and returns exact batch-versus-single parity for service, package, shipping, other, insurance, and confirmation components.

Cross-order, cross-account, and mismatched rate facts remain rejected before provider activity; the rollout probe also rejects unattributed rows, component drift, a non-multi-UPS topology, and carrier-limit truncation.

The production flag is enabled on the rate-owning API and sync worker, and the read-only three-day canary shows an estimated 80.06 percent provider-call reduction with negligible limiter wait and bounded provider duration.

Certification uses carrier discovery, rate estimates, and read-only diagnostics only; it cannot buy a label or mutate orders, shipments, billing, inventory, marketplace state, or shipped/cancelled history.
Focused batching, exact-rate, cache, source-of-truth, strict TypeScript, production frontend build, and all 49 mandatory source-of-truth gates pass.

canonicalOwners: src/services/rates.ts owns credential-scoped carrier discovery, batched fan-out admission, completeness, targeted fallback, cache writes, and flag-off behavior
src/services/shipstation-rate-batch.ts owns requested-account attribution and rejects missing, unknown, or out-of-scope carrier rows
scripts/probe-batched-rate-estimate.ts owns operator-only rollout comparison evidence and never becomes runtime rate truth

oldOwners.path: scripts/probe-batched-rate-estimate.ts fixed six-account registry assumption and aggregate money comparison
oldOwners.delegatesTo: live ShipStation carrier discovery plus independent component signatures in the operator probe

wrappers.delegatesTo: ShipStation live carrier availability and the unchanged backend canonical rate/fan-out owners

sotBypass.details: The ticket changes only rollout evidence. It does not rank, select, authorize, persist, or purchase a rate, and the runtime backend owners remain unchanged.

evidence.proves: Injected provider replay exercises the real canonical rate owner for complete, partial, failed, and disabled batching states while the probe guard forbids label purchase and order or shipment mutation paths.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-433-rate-boundary with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: The real backend quote boundary integrates with an injected provider seam and rejects mismatched order, account, and shipment/rate facts before any provider effect.

evidence.command: npm run test:ps-433-rate-boundary with inert test-only environment values
evidence.proves: Adversarial cross-order, cross-account, and stale or mismatched facts fail closed before the injected provider spy is touched.

evidence.command: npm run test:probe-batched-rate-estimate && npm run test:shipstation-batched-rate-fanout
evidence.proves: The offline comparison contract fails on equal-and-opposite money-component drift, unattributed or missing rows, fewer than two live UPS accounts, and any max-carrier value that would truncate live UPS coverage.

Two distinct live credential sources passed in one run: DR PREPPER matched 65 batch rows to 65 single rows across five UPS, USPS, and FedEx accounts, and KFG matched 65 to 65 across all seven accounts.

evidence.command: Read-only production rate_cache diagnostic SELECT for the 2026-07-18 through 2026-07-21 canary window
evidence.proves: Across 766 cache rows, observed flag-on calls were 953 versus an estimated 4,780 flag-off calls (80.06 percent reduction); limiter wait averaged 0.01 ms with 0 ms p95, and batch duration averaged 2.98 seconds with 5.83 seconds p95.

migrations.rollbackPlan: No schema or data rollback is required. Disable SHIPSTATION_BATCHED_RATE_FANOUT on the API and sync worker for an immediate runtime rollback, then redeploy a reviewed prior SHA or forward-revert only the batching implementation and proof commits.

rollback.strategy: First disable SHIPSTATION_BATCHED_RATE_FANOUT on the API and sync worker if live rate completeness or latency crosses the documented stop thresholds. If code rollback is still required, forward-revert the batching implementation and proof commits and redeploy the same reviewed SHA to Vercel, API, sync worker, and print worker. Do not mutate orders, shipments, labels, Billing, inventory, or provider state during rollback.

liveVerification.reason: A live all-source provider estimate probe passed exact batch-versus-single parity across every currently discoverable account, and read-only production canary diagnostics verified request reduction and timing without an operational Recalculate All write.
